content.short: Superform is a leading omnichain yield marketplace that enables users to access DeFi vaults across chains.
content.description: Superform is a revolutionary decentralized protocol designed to serve as a unified marketplace for yield-generating strategies across the multichain Web3 landscape. By utilizing advanced cross-chain infrastructure, Superform enables users to deposit digital assets into any supported DeFi vault on any blockchain through a single intuitive interface. The platform focuses on maximizing capital efficiency and simplifying the process of yield discovery and management for both retail and institutional investors. With its robust security framework and permissionless access, Superform acts as a critical discovery layer for liquidity, fostering a more interconnected and accessible decentralized finance ecosystem for everyone.
content.meta: Superform is the premier omnichain yield marketplace, offering seamless access to decentralized vaults and optimized yield discovery for Web3 users.

resources.title: Setting the Standard for Transparency
resources.tldr: Opens by noting how many consumer apps now hold your crypto while telling you very little about where it sits. A pointed piece on what disclosure should actually mean.

resources.title: Introducing SuperformOS: Verifiable Strategy Engines for Programmable Vaults
resources.tldr: Most 'non-custodial' vaults are still black boxes: what the vault may do, how it rebalances, how pricing updates all live offchain in private scripts. An attempt to move that logic where it can be checked.
